events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on this day in 1943.

angles.name: Jagger's enduring energy
angles.copy: The legendary Mick Jagger celebrates his 83rd birthday today! Six decades in, still moving like Jagger.

events.title: MTV launched (1981)
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on this day in 1981, forever changing the music landscape with its 24/7 music video format. The first video played was 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles.

angles.name: MTV's revolution
angles.copy: 45 years ago today, MTV burst onto our screens, kicking off with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star? We think not!

events.title: Oasis: Definitely Maybe released (1994)
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Britpop classic
angles.copy: It's 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. A true Britpop masterpiece that defined a generation. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary (1969)
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York, for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. A defining moment for music and culture. Peace, love, and incredible tunes!

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91 in 2026.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy live on.

events.title: The Beatles: Abbey Road released (1969)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman, still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, best known as the lead singer of Oasis, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Celebrating Liam G
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon: Imagine single released (1971)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod's impact
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy and incredible theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940. He passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Today, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Marwood Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true icon of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles: 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the double LP?
